agent_update_desc:
The agent downloads the new version, replaces itself and restarts.
This can take up to 60 seconds (confirmation is awaited).
agent_uninstall_desc:
This will: 1) stop the agent, 2) delete all agent data on the client,
3) remove the client from the dashboard – but only if it really goes offline.

This can take up to 60 seconds. Please wait.

exp_relay_login_desc: Sign in with your normal dashboard login:
exp_relay_cmd_hint: run Command Prompt (cmd) and append your password directly. The „WebClient" service must be running first (net start webclient).
exp_relay_letter_hint: Any free letter works instead of Z:. /persistent:yes is already included so the drive survives a reboot. The form
exp_relay_unc_hint: is the official WebDAV notation with a port -
exp_relay_colon_warn: with a colon (that makes Windows try SMB and ends in error 67 / 0x800704b3).
exp_relay_step1: The „WebClient" service must be running: in cmd (as admin) run net start webclient.
exp_relay_step3: Pick a drive letter and enter the http://…:port/dav address from above as the folder (with a colon before the port).
exp_relay_step4: Tick „Connect using different credentials" → Finish → enter your dashboard login.
exp_relay_warn_colon: Important: never use the form \\host:port\dav with a colon – Windows then tries SMB and reports error 67 / 0x800704b3. Use the http://…/dav address in the graphical dialog; in cmd (net use) use the WebDAV form \\host@port\dav from above.
exp_relay_online_note: The client has to be online for its folder to show any content.
exp_relay_admin_must: An administrator has to share it.
ac_help: What the installation does: the agent is installed to C:\Program Files\RapalleRmmAgent (Windows) or /opt/rapalle-rmm-agent (Linux). If Python is missing it is installed automatically. The required libraries go into their own environment. The agent is set up as a service that starts at boot - even without anyone logging in - and then registers itself here in the dashboard.
ac_uncat_hint: Without a tenant/location the client automatically lands in the „Uncategorized" tenant and can be moved any time via „Edit".
ac_win_hint: The Windows installer installs Python itself if needed and sets up the invisible autostart. You can simply close PowerShell afterwards.
ac_no_installer_support: This backend does not support installer packages yet.
pm_head_hint: permissions here apply on top of group permissions (deny wins)
pm_removed_ad: Taken out of the AD folder
pm_pick_subject: Pick a user or a group on the left.
pm_global_help:
Global permissions. Allow = grant, Deny = hard revoke (beats any allow, including from groups), — = not set.
The Admin and ⭐ Super admin permissions are full access (wildcard) – Super admin matches exactly the „admin" setting used when creating a user and shows the same ADMIN tag next to the name.
pm_admin_note: This user already has the „admin" role and therefore all permissions anyway – settings here only take effect once the role is changed.
pm_client_help: Client-specific permissions. See/access clients controls visibility — without that permission (or with Deny) the client is hidden from the subject and nothing is possible there.
pm_default_help: Whatever is set to Allow here applies automatically on every client – including newly added ones. A Deny on an individual client further down always overrides that allow.
set_proxy_hint: Public access / reverse proxy: enter the public address at which agents reach the backend. This value is baked into the agent installation — otherwise an agent gets the internally reachable address {origin}, which an external client cannot reach.
set_hostlock_hint: Only allows requests via the addresses stored above. If only a domain is entered, a request via the local IP is rejected.
set_hostlock_warn:
Two things to know first:
1. The Host header can be spoofed. This keeps scanners and accidental access out – a real barrier is only a firewall.
2. Agents are connected using the address they were set up with (usually the IP). Scope „agents too" then cuts off the entire fleet until every agent has been set up again.
From the server itself http://localhost always stays reachable – you can undo the lock through it if needed.
set_proxy_warn: Only switch „Yes" on if there really is a proxy in front: otherwise anyone can send the header themselves and bypass the lock.
set_srvupd_hint: Updates the RMM server straight from the GitHub repo. The backend restarts automatically after an update.
set_auto_update_note: Auto-update settings are stored with „{save}" below.
set_db_hint: Where the RMM data lives: Local (SQLite file in the backend) or External (MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL or a SQLite file, e.g. on a network share). Switching copies all data (local → external or external → local) and restarts the backend. In external mode the external DB is the persistent store and is kept in sync during operation.
set_db_backup_hint: A backup is created automatically before every switch. If something goes wrong while copying it is restored immediately and the mode stays unchanged. The last 5 are kept.
set_db_restore_desc: The current local state will be replaced. The backend restarts afterwards.
set_db_restoring: Restoring backup — the backend is restarting.
set_db_progress_lost_hint: The progress can no longer be queried. The switch continues in the backend - reload the page in a minute.
set_db_failed_restored: Switch failed — the local database was restored from the backup.
set_db_failed_unchanged: Switch failed — the mode was not changed.
set_backend_restarting: The backend is restarting — the page will reload shortly.
set_agent_autoupd_hint: Updates outdated agents automatically as soon as they connect to the backend (same mechanism as the „Update agent" button). Can be overridden per client under „Edit client" → automatic agent update.
set_agent_autoupd_offline: Update offline clients as soon as they are back online
set_agent_autoupd_offline_hint: With the box ticked, outdated agents are updated right when they reconnect. Without it, only clients that are already online when a new agent version becomes available are updated.
set_update_all_hint: Update all agents right now: an agent update is triggered for every currently connected client you are allowed to manage. The agents update themselves and reconnect.
set_update_all_offline: Queue offline clients too (update as soon as they are back online)
set_upd_notify_short: you will be notified once they are all reconnected.
set_upd_notify_long: You will be notified as soon as all clients are reconnected.
set_recording_hint: Controls how remote sessions are recorded as replays — for the screen agent and for Guacamole (RDP/VNC/SSH/Telnet). Higher values = sharper/smoother, but larger files.
set_br_hint: Here you can replace all logos and the login background with your own files. The format has to match the slot (PNG/JPG/ICO), max. 8 MB. Changes take effect immediately — you may need to reload the page (Ctrl+F5), since the browser caches images.
set_spotify_hint: Client ID of your own Spotify app (developer.spotify.com → Dashboard → create app). Users can then sign in with their Spotify account in the 🎵 Audio Player; with Premium the player plays full tracks with its own controls.
set_spotify_redirect: Redirect URI (enter it in the Spotify dashboard):
set_spotify_uri_hint: It is taken automatically from the full URL above – so there is no separate field. If nothing is entered there, the address you currently have the dashboard open at is used.
set_spotify_both: To be safe, enter both spellings in the Spotify dashboard – with and without a trailing slash
set_spotify_exact: The entry in the Spotify dashboard has to match character for character – including the port and the trailing /.
set_spotify_bad_uri: Spotify does not accept this address: only https://… or {example} are allowed. Enter your HTTPS address under „full URL" above – or open the dashboard via 127.0.0.1.
set_relay_hint: The relay exposes the client files as a network drive. WebDAV, FTP and SFTP can be enabled individually — everything runs over the same port as the dashboard, no further firewall openings are needed. FTP and SFTP are mutually exclusive.
set_deploy_hint: The folder Deployment can additionally be published as a small website. Everything in it is then reachable via a link without signing in — handy for quickly passing on an image, a script or an installer.
set_docker_hint: If the RMM runs as a container, additional services can be enabled here as neighbouring containers. The dashboard then fills the matching addresses and credentials into the fields below automatically. This requires the mounted Docker socket; if it is missing, a note appears here.
set_docker_no_socket: The Docker socket is not mounted — without it the backend cannot start neighbouring containers. In docker-compose.yml, enable the line /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock under volumes of the rmm service and run docker compose up -d.
set_saved_below: Host and port are stored with „{save}" below.
set_ftp_unsupported: This backend does not know about FTP access yet.
set_webdav_hint: takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
set_ftp_oneport: control AND data run over this single port — no further port has to be opened.
set_listener_pending: {mode} is configured but is not running: the listener is only set up when the backend starts. Please restart the backend.
set_ftp_nat_hint: Note for FTP behind Docker/NAT: enter the IP address at which the clients reach the RMM under „Server" above — it is announced to the FTP client for the data connection.
set_login_dashboard_creds: Sign in with your dashboard credentials.
set_saved_needs_restart_admin: Saved. The change only takes effect after a restart — please ask an administrator to restart the RMM.
set_restart_desc: FTP and SFTP only become active after a backend restart. Running sessions will be dropped.
set_saved_next_restart: Saved. Takes effect after the next restart.
set_ask_admin_restart: please ask an administrator to restart the RMM.
set_dep_public_hint: without signing in. Only enable this if there is nothing confidential in the folder.
set_dep_html_ph: Leave empty for the automatic file list.
set_dep_files_hint: Put files into the „Deployment" folder in the relay explorer.
set_pw_otp: One-time password (user sets their own on first login)
set_admin_via_perm: Full access via the super_admin permission
set_otp_note: Write it down now - it is shown only once.
pr_icons_svg: SVG icons (recommended, identical on every system)
pr_icons_hint: SVG icons look identical on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. System emojis use the device's emoji font (which may be missing on Linux/Android and show up as empty boxes).
pr_layout_edit_label: Move and resize views freely & adjust folders
pr_layout_edit_hint: With editing on, you can rearrange status, actions and overview folders in the client view by dragging, drag their width, create more folders and move sub-views (metrics/notes/disk) between folders. The ↗️ icon detaches any block into its own window (even without editing). You can drag clients from the sidebar straight onto the workspace.
pr_bars_hint: Hide the top bar and the taskbar automatically so windows and content get more room. On a PC they reappear as soon as the mouse reaches the top or bottom edge of the screen. On a phone, show them with the buttons at the top left (next to ☰).
pr_restore_hint: Decide what is restored when you sign in again. If an item is off, you start „clean" from the dashboard at that point.
pr_silent_hint: With this mode active, the consent dialog on the device is skipped for the next remote screen session. The mode switches itself off again once the connection is established. Useful, for example, when someone is signed in but away and something urgent has to be done. Every use is recorded in the audit log.
pr_silent_used: Silent mode was used for the session{on} and is OFF again.
pr_status_unavailable: Status not available: {msg} - is the backend running the current version (auth_routes.py/sockets.py)?
pr_rc_direct: Direct: selection = copy, otherwise paste (PuTTY style)
pr_rc_menu: Context menu: copy / paste / copy all
pr_shortcuts_hint: Shortcuts always work: Ctrl+Shift+C copies (or Ctrl+C with a selection), Ctrl+V pastes, Ctrl+Ins/Shift+Ins the classic way. The setting takes effect immediately, including in open terminals.
pr_realm_pw: Your account is managed centrally through the directory (AD/LDAP/SSO). The password can only be changed there — not in the RMM.
pr_2fa_hint: A one-time code from an authenticator app on top of the password (Aegis, FreeOTP, Google/Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden …). A stolen password alone is then useless.
pr_2fa_unsupported: This backend does not support two-factor authentication yet.
pr_2fa_codes_hint: Save them now: they are shown only this once. One of these codes gets you in without your phone – each works once.
pr_confirm_realm:
Your account is managed through a directory (AD/LDAP/SSO).

ap_sp_both_hint: It is best to enter both spellings in the dashboard – Spotify compares character for character, and the trailing slash is the most common mistake:
ap_sp_step1: Open your app on developer.spotify.com/dashboard (or create a new one).
ap_sp_step2: Settings → Redirect URIs: paste the URI(s) above, click Add for each and do not forget Save at the bottom – without saving, Spotify reports „No redirect URI configured“.
ap_sp_step3: Compare the spelling exactly: upper/lower case, every letter of the hostname, the port and the slash. A single character difference gives „redirect_uri: Not matching configuration“.
ap_sp_step4: Under APIs used, Web API (and Web Playback SDK for the full player) has to be enabled.
ap_sp_step5: Enter the client ID from the app under Settings → General → Spotify.
ap_sp_http_hint: The redirect URI is built from Settings → General → „full URL“. If the dashboard only runs over HTTP on the LAN, open it via {url} – Spotify does not allow HTTP otherwise.

ap_sp_endpoint_missing: Spotify login: the backend endpoint is missing (/api/auth/spotify-config).

agent_err_no_helper: The agent runs as a service in session 0 and cannot capture the desktop from there. The helper for the user session did not report in. Check whether anyone is signed in on the device. The helper log is in the signed-in user's TEMP folder as rmm-screen-helper.log (type %TEMP% in Explorer). [Sessions with a signed-in user: {sessions}]
agent_err_no_display: The screen cannot be captured. Common cause: the PC is a headless VM/server WITHOUT an active graphical session (no monitor, nobody signed in, or reachable only via RDP). Without a real screen session there is nothing to transmit. Fix: stay signed in on the device, provide a (virtual) monitor, or install a virtual display driver. [Technical: {tech}]

agent_no_display: No graphical screen found (headless VM/server). A shell will be opened instead.
agent_mode_no_packages: Screen streaming not possible: mss/Pillow cannot be loaded ({err}). Python: {python}. A shell will be opened instead.
agent_err_consent_denied: The user at the device did not confirm remote screen access.
